concepts.title: Reference base and hole
concepts.instruction: Construct the regular hexagon with 20 mm sides and its concentric Ø20 hole in plan.

concepts.title: Reference elevation
concepts.instruction: Project the six outer vertices and hole generators to the 50 mm elevation.

concepts.title: Isometric outer base
concepts.instruction: Use the hexagon bounding rectangle and transferred vertex offsets to construct the isometric base.

concepts.title: Outer prism
concepts.instruction: Erect the 50 mm verticals and close the top hexagon.

concepts.title: Hole centre and rhombus
concepts.instruction: Locate the common axis in the top face and construct the Ø20 hole rhombus.

concepts.title: Hole arcs and projection
concepts.instruction: Draw the hole rim as successive arcs and project the coaxial opening to the lower end, following the source visible/hidden line convention.

concepts.title: Finish
concepts.instruction: Retain the internal guides and add 20 mm side, Ø20 hole and 50 mm height annotations.

notes: The reference drawing shows the bottom hole and internal generators as construction/hidden details. Preserve them; do not render a filled solid top face that closes the hole.
